sheet.title: Prepare the diamond
sheet.instruction: Place a thin 34 cm square on one corner, front side up. Make a light center mark at the intersection of its diagonals.
sheet.result: All eight petals will come from this one sheet.

blintz-base.title: Bring the corners to the center
blintz-base.instruction: Valley-fold the four corners to the center. Line up adjacent flap edges without crossing them.
blintz-base.result: Four loose points meet on top of a smaller square.

hem-tips.title: Double the tips
hem-tips.instruction: At each corner mark 2.6 cm along both edges. Valley-fold the tip inward between those marks.
hem-tips.result: Each corner now has a short, doubled lip.

raise-first.title: Raise the first petals
raise-first.instruction: Fold the upper-right and lower-left flaps toward you on the lines between adjacent edge midpoints. Stop at about 49°.
raise-first.result: Two opposite petals stand above the flat diamond.

raise-second.title: Raise the other pair
raise-second.instruction: Lift the other two flaps to the same angle. Keep all four sides of the diamond flat on the table.
raise-second.result: Four walls surround the open flower.

crimp-first.title: Crimp two petals
crimp-first.instruction: On the upper-right flap pinch a rib from the right midpoint toward a spot 3.4 cm left of the top-right corner. At 7.2 and 9.2 cm along the rib, bend it inward and back out on the chevrons shown. Hold the broad side still and carry all four layers through the upper turn. Repeat on the opposite petal.
crimp-first.result: The middle rib reverses and the doubled lip turns outward.

crimp-second.title: Turn the last two lips
crimp-second.instruction: Rotate the flower a quarter turn. Repeat the two reverses in each remaining petal, working in the same direction around the center.
crimp-second.result: Four cupped, clockwise-turning petals frame an open diamond.

lift-inner-sides.title: Lift the side petals
lift-inner-sides.instruction: Find the loose points that came from the right and left of the original sheet. Lift only those flaps along the short upright guides about 5.5 cm out from the center. Stop at 78°.
lift-inner-sides.result: Two pointed inner petals rise between the crimped outer petals.

lift-inner-ends.title: Open the inner whorl
lift-inner-ends.instruction: Lift the other two loose points on their marked bases to about 65°. Leave the center open.
lift-inner-ends.result: Four pointed petals stand inside four curled outer lips.
